title: Bitcoin’s Price Jumps Above $85,000 on Lighter-Than-Expected Inflation Data
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Bitcoin’s Price Jumps Above $85,000 on Lighter-Than-Expected Inflation Data The August personal consumption expenditures price index came in lower than expected and bitcoin’s price jumped — a little. This post Bitcoin’s Price Jumps Above $85,000 on Lighter-Than-Expected Inflation Data first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Mathew Di Salvo .
